name: 3-Board Bench Press
description: The 3-Board Bench Press stacks three 2-inch boards on the chest, leaving only the top 5-6 inches of the press range to complete. At this board height the movement is almost entirely triceps-driven, with minimal pectoral stretch-shortening involvement. It is used specifically for lockout strength development and as a heavy overload tool.

execution.starting_position: Lie on a flat bench. Partner holds three stacked boards against the chest. Grip the bar at shoulder-width or slightly narrower to maximize tricep involvement.
execution.setup_instructions: Stack three 2x6 boards or use a padded board block. The bar need only travel 5-6 inches to complete the movement. Load can be significantly above full ROM maximum.
steps: Step 1: Unrack bar and lower to the board stack.
Step 3: Drive explosively to full lockout.
Step 4: Return under control and repeat.
execution.breathing_instructions: Brace fully before each rep. Exhale at lockout.
common_mistakes: Using an overly wide grip that shifts load back to the chest rather than triceps
Failing to reach full elbow lockout
safety_considerations: Very heavy loads are possible — trained spotters are mandatory
Do not attempt without reliable partner support
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Top 5-6 inches of pressing ROM only. Full lockout required.
coaching_cues: Squeeze the triceps hard at lockout
Think 'push the ceiling away' for maximum extension
